title: Environmental DNA (eDNA) Metabarcoding Protocol for Amphibian Species
author: Alexander Eiler
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.973h9qn
materials: For DNA extraction use Qiagen DNeasy power water sterivex kit. The quality of the extracted DNA can be estimated using Nanodrop. Qiagen DNeasy power water sterivex kit: https://www.qiagen.com/se/resources/resourcedetail?id=c5fe7d5f-070a-4ebe-ac04-4bbf05a13e91&lang=en

Illumina MiDeq Next Generation sequencer Sequencing was performed on the Illumina MiSeq platform that generated paired end sequence that where 150 bp in length. Analysis was carried out by DADA2 pipeline https://benjjneb.github.io/dada2/tutorial.html .

For DNA extraction use Qiagen DNeasy power water sterivex kit. The quality of the extracted DNA can be estimated using Nanodrop. Qiagen DNeasy power water sterivex kit: https://www.qiagen.com/se/resources/resourcedetail?id=c5fe7d5f-070a-4ebe-ac04-4bbf05a13e91&lang=en

steps.title: First PCR reaction setup
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL first‑PCR mix for each sample (triplicate or duplicate) using the following components: 5 µL 5× Q5 Reaction Buffer (final 1×), 0.5 µL batra_F primer (10 µM stock, final 0.2 µM; sequence 5′‑ACA CTC TTT CCC TAC ACG ACG CTC TTC CGA TCT NNN NNN ACA CCG CCC GTC ACC CT‑3′), 0.5 µL batra_R primer (10 µM stock, final 0.2 µM; sequence 5′‑AGA CGT GTG CTC TTC CGA TCT NNN NNN GTA YAC TTA CCA TGT TAC GAC TT‑3′), 2.5 µL dNTPs (2 mM stock, final 0.2 mM), 2 µL human‑blocking primer batra_blk (50 µM stock, final 4 µM; sequence TCACCCTCCTCAAGTATACTTCAAAGGCA‑SPC3I), 0.25 µL Q5 HF DNA polymerase (2 U/µL, final 0.02 U/µL), 5 µL template DNA, and 9.25 µL nuclease‑free water. Mix gently and briefly centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Add each reagent in the order listed.
Mix by pipetting up‑and‑down, avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Run first PCR
steps.instruction: Thermocycle the 25 µL reactions on a PCR machine with the following program: Initial denaturation 98 °C for 30 s; 30 cycles of 98 °C for 20 s, 60 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 1 min; final extension 72 °C for 7 min; hold at 6 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Second PCR with indexing primers
steps.instruction: Set up a second‑PCR to attach Illumina adapters and sample‑specific indices. Use the multiplex forward primer (Multiplex_fwd: AATGATACGGCGACCACCGAGA{TCTACAC}‑[i5 index]‑ACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACG) and multiplex reverse primer (Multiplex_rev: CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGAT‑[i7 index]‑GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCT). Up to 20 different forward and 20 different reverse indexed primers can be combined (400 possible tag combinations). Prepare the PCR mix (volumes not specified in the source) and run the following program: Initial denaturation 98 °C for 30 s; 15 cycles of 98 °C for 10 s, 66 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 30 s; final extension 72 °C for 2 min; hold at 6 °C indefinitely.

substeps.instruction: Add indexing primers at the appropriate concentrations.
Add template (first‑PCR product) and other PCR reagents.
Mix, spin down, and place in thermocycler.

steps.title: Quantify second PCR
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of each second‑PCR product using a PicoGreen dsDNA assay according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Pool PCR products equally
steps.instruction: Combine all second‑PCR products so that each contributes the same amount of DNA (ng) or, for amplicons of different length, the same number of molecules (mol). Calculate the target DNA amount using the lowest‑concentration sample: multiply its concentration (ng/µL) by its volume (µL) to obtain the target ng. For each other sample, divide the target ng by its concentration to obtain the volume to add. Pipette the calculated volumes of each sample into a single tube, using the same pipette throughout to minimise calibration error.

substeps.instruction: Identify the sample with the lowest concentration.
For each sample, calculate required volume = target ng / sample concentration.
Pipette the calculated volumes into one tube.

steps.title: Verify pool on agarose gel
steps.instruction: Run a 1 % agarose gel electrophoresis of the pooled library to confirm a single, clean band. Excise the band and perform gel purification. After purification, re‑measure the DNA concentration with PicoGreen before submitting to the sequencing facility.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1 % agarose gel and load an aliquot of the pool.
Run electrophoresis and visualise under UV.
Excise the correct band and purify using a gel‑extraction kit.
Quantify the purified pool with PicoGreen.

steps.title: Purify pooled replicates with beads
steps.instruction: If PCRs were performed in triplicate or duplicate, pool those replicates together and clean the combined amplicons using Agencourt AMPure magnetic beads following the protocol linked in the source.

substeps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of AMPure beads to the pooled replicate mixture.
Separate beads on a magnetic rack and wash twice with 70 % ethanol.
Elute purified DNA in nuclease‑free water or TE buffer.

steps.title: Final gel check
steps.instruction: Run a second 1 % agarose gel electrophoresis on the bead‑purified pool to verify that a single, sharp band is present before final submission.
